items.title: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper
items.desc: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper The skyscraper housing Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) in Riyadh was damaged on Thursday by a Houthi strike, the kingdom has confirmed. The strike destroyed windows across seven to eight floors of the tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, and bent part of its metal facade, according to a Reuters journalist. Video footage shared from the Saudi capital showed crews already working to replace the glass. items.title: Saudi ministers meet US Centcom, Mecca Defence Alliance chiefs
items.desc: Saudi ministers meet US Centcom, Mecca Defence Alliance chiefs US Central Command (Centcom) chief Brad Cooper met Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh, according to the Saudi Press Agency on Thursday. The agency also reported that Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud discussed “strengthening coordination and joint defense cooperation” during a meeting with Mecca Defence Alliance secretary general Nauman Mahmood.

items.title: Iran war costs surpass $48bn, US Pentagon official says
items.desc: Iran war costs surpass $48bn, US Pentagon official says The war against Iran has cost the US more than $48bn since it launched attacks with Israel in late February, a Pentagon official told lawmakers on Thursday. "As of November 13, it was $48.3 billion," the Pentagon's deputy comptroller, Arthur Miller, said. Reporting by AFP
